US.description: Includes Federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average state income tax for an $85k USD earner.

IN.description: Effective tax rate includes central income tax and a health & education cess, based on the new tax regime for an individual earning $85k USD (approx. 7.08M INR).

SG.description: Progressive income tax based on brackets, does not include mandatory CPF contributions; 9% Goods and Services Tax (GST) applies to most goods and services.

CH.description: Effective rate for an $85k USD earner in Zurich, including federal, cantonal, communal income taxes, and mandatory social security contributions.

NL.description: Includes progressive income tax (Box 1) and national insurance contributions.

GB.description: Includes income tax and National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income tax for Ontario, Canada Pension Plan (CPP), and Employment Insurance (EI).

AE.description: No personal income tax for residents of the UAE, including an $85k USD earner.

NO.description: Includes federal income tax, national insurance contribution, and progressive bracket tax.

IE.description: Includes income tax (PAYE), Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Effective rate including progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD equivalent earner (approx. $130k AUD).

QA.description: No personal income tax for residents. Social security contributions may apply to Qatari nationals.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam has no personal income tax for its residents.

MO.description: Effective personal income tax is very low, based on a progressive system with generous deductions for an $85k USD earner.
